truth_scope: existing current integrated-aware LP truth only; no solver rerun
wavelength_resolved_common_grid: 400-500 nm, 1 nm; null denotes absent frozen evidence, not an extrapolation

I03_evidence_boundary.upward_source_normalized_power_pair: only the 450 nm anchor is available in the frozen I03 evidence
I03_evidence_boundary.C_angular: only 440, 450, and 460 nm are available in pair_angular_cancellation_metrics.csv

power_collapse_assessment.description: IAR4 450 nm upward power, pair S0, and axis-free useful LP are comparable to or modestly above the frozen I03 anchor; this is descriptive only and does not define a promotion threshold.
power_collapse_assessment.broadband_power_scope: IAR4 has complete 400-500 nm pair power spectra; I03 upward power is anchor-only, so no fabricated I03 broadband upward-power comparison is made.

source_normalization_boundary: relative/source-normalized evidence only; no absolute emitted-power or W_emit claim
